title: Wedding-ready skin, planned to the day
narration: Namaste! India hosts around forty-six lakh weddings in one six-week season. Brides, grooms and guests all want to glow, but most start skin prep too late and buy looks they have never tried. Meet ShaadiGlow.

title: Pick a sample bride, or take a guided selfie
narration: It's a mobile web app. I'll pick Ananya, a sample bride in Mumbai, eight weeks out. Real users can take a guided selfie with YouCam's JS Camera Kit.

title: Date, city, budget and events
narration: She confirms her wedding date, city, budget, and the events she'll attend, from haldi to the reception.

title: AI Skin Analysis v2.1: 12 concerns
narration: The photo goes through YouCam's File API, then AI Skin Analysis version two point one measures twelve concerns, chosen to fit the fourteen-unit tier.

title: Scores, skin age and AI masks
narration: Her report shows a skin score, skin age, and T-zone versus cheek skin type. Tap a concern to see where the AI looked. Oil control and dark circles are her focus.

title: AI Skin Simulation: her wedding-day goal
narration: AI Skin Simulation previews a realistic wedding-day goal, labelled as a preview, not a promise.

title: A countdown plan you can audit
narration: The countdown plan comes from a deterministic rules engine. Her scores map to ingredients and a morning and night routine, tuned to Mumbai's humidity and UV, her budget, and the days left. Every step has a why, and it enforces wedding rules: patch tests, nothing new in the final fourteen days, and natural henna only.

title: One call = one complete event look
narration: In the look studio, each event is one AI Makeup Virtual Try-On request that stacks lipstick, kohl, eyeshadow, blush, highlighter and a shade-matched foundation. One unit, one complete pheras look.

title: Hair colour, jhumkas and more
narration: AI Hair Color tries a burgundy shade, and AI Earrings tries temple jhumkas. Necklaces use the AI Necklace try-on, and grooms get the AI Beard Style Generator.

title: Shop the look: one cart
narration: Everything she tried lands in one cart, each item tagged with the concern it treats, in a clearly marked sample store.

title: Re-scans that respect noise
narration: Every two weeks, a quick re-scan of four concerns costs nine units, and only changes beyond normal scan noise count as progress. Here's the sample groom's re-scan.

title: Built to spend units once
narration: Under the hood: FastAPI, a disk cache so no call is ever paid twice, a unit budget guard, and full Hindi support. ShaadiGlow: wedding-ready skin, planned to the day.
